# `ext::window` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/window.lani#L3)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Lanius-owned windows, event translation and RGB scaling through direct libX11 calls. Native Linux x86_64/glibc, depth-24 TrueColor X11/XWayland only. Explicit manual owners and same-thread access; close windows before their context. Local failure Results do not replace Xlib's process-fatal protocol/I/O handlers. Native pixels, events, reached failure cleanup and an interactive application have executable tests. No SDL or production C shim. Native Wayland is unimplemented; ext::gpu uses the native-window lease for Vulkan presentation.
